text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Please take a looook~!

While walking in front of the station, I 
bumped into Hishi Akebono handing out 
promotional flyers. Looking at the paper 
handed to me, it was an ad for a 
restaurant.
choice_data_list: Helping out at an acquaintance's place?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yup! It's my favorite regular spot~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But... they haven't been getting many 
customers lately, and they seem to be in 
trouble.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All the food here has such a warm, gentle 
flavor—it's totally bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I eat here, it fills me with so 
much happiness.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, I really wanted to return the favor. 
Plus, I want lots of people to know how 
tasty their food is~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That way I'll be happy, the owners will be 
happy, and the customers who come to eat 
will all be bono too, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So I asked the manager to let me hand out 
flyers!
choice_data_list: I see... so how's it going?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, not so great... People take the 
flyers, but that's about it~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-san. What do you think we can 
do to get more customers to come in?
choice_data_list: Introduce the shop on social media!
How about rethinking the flyer's content?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Like streaming a video on Umasta? 
Though promoting stuff usually needs a 
catchy hook, doesn't it?
I heard *everything*!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Pearl-san?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You wish to broadcast your beloved shop to 
the whole wide world! I understand that 
feeling to my very core...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Leave the global streaming strategy to me! 
I shall provide my utmost support!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's so reassuring~! Thank you, 
Pearl-san!

And so, produced by Seeking the Pearl and 
starring Hishi Akebono, a promotional 
video shoot for the restaurant was 
underway!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
When showcasing cuisine, a food review is 
the most *effective* approach! Now, let's 
*tasting*!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This omelet rice is made with freshly laid 
eggs gathered this morning. That's why the 
yolk flavor is so rich and the texture is 
extra fluffy~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Time to eat~! Nom nom nom...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! The sweetness of the soft-cooked egg 
and the tanginess of the ketchup rice 
blend together in perfect harmony... Bono!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That facial expression is *good*! However, 
that alone won't reach the *audience* 
across the screen.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To make it instantly crystal clear to 
anyone across the globe, you must express 
it even more *dynamically*! Yes—just like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: *Delicious*!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see~! Moving your whole body is the 
secret to getting the message across!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Alright~! I'm gonna spread heaps of bono~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Bo~~no~~♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, *excellent*! Give me more! Show me 
your big *delight*!!

Eating with great relish and dancing with 
pure joy! Hishi Akebono's PR video went 
viral on Umasta, and customers started 
pouring into the restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the content, huh. Aside from 
recommended dishes, what else should we 
put on it~?

Um... how about mentioning how gentle it 
is on the body?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Miracle-san?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for eavesdropping. But when I heard 
you talking about a place I know, I 
couldn't help myself...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Are you a regular at that shop too, 
Miracle-san?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. They have a varied menu, and every 
dish is gentle on the body.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, totally! The veggies are organically 
grown, and they go light on oil, so it's 
super healthy~!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I think it's perfect for health-conscious 
people. Highlighting that might be a good 
idea.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Then let's remake the flyer 
to focus on the healthiness~!

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, would it be alright if I helped pass 
out flyers? I want to support the shop 
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really, you would?

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Their food has given me a lot of 
energy in the past.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~! Let's do our best 
together and bring in lots of customers!

A few days later. Peeking into the Western 
diner, it was packed almost to capacity. 
The revamped flyers seemed to have done 
the trick.

text_block_list.name: KS Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This soup really warms you from the inside 
out...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
More customers are coming, the food is 
delicious... I'm feeling so, so bono right 
now~!

Watching Hishi Akebono and the others 
happily gather around the dining table... 
my own heart felt pleasantly warmed.
